newsitem.title: CROATIA: SOCCER-CROATIA RETAINS CUP TO COMPLETE DOUBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA RETAINS CUP TO COMPLETE DOUBLE.

text.p: Croatia, who recently won the league title, completed a double on Thursday by adding the Croatian Cup with a 2-1 victory over Zagreb, another team from the capital.

Croatia's best scorer, Igor Cvitanovic, put his team in the lead with a 30th minute penalty and Mark Viduka added an effective second by scoring with a backheel in the 65th minute after a pass by Danijel Saric.
Zeljko Sopic scored for Zagreb 13 minutes from time after fooling Croatia's goalkeeper Drazen Ladic.
